name: Traffic Automaton
desc: A Biham-Middleton-Levine traffic cellular automaton where red and blue cars self-organize into striking diagonal free-flow bands on a dark road, tipping into gridlock jams as the section builds.

density.doc: car fill fraction (low=ordered diagonal free-flow, high=gridlock jam)

scale.doc: cell size (higher = bigger chunkier cars, coarser grid)

hue.doc: base hue of the red-car type (blue offset +212)
